basis: measured from Helmcode gateway usage.cost_details on non-streaming completions, 2026-09-03

Z.AI upstream.note: every probe at benchmark prompt size routed here

Parasail upstream.note: one long-prompt call; same served model id

repeat-prompt input.note: effective input rate on an immediately repeated prompt, despite extra_body caching:false

per_run_cost_note: The STREAMING response the runner uses carries neither `provider` nor `cost`; both appear only on non-streaming calls. Per-run cost is therefore derived from measured rates and recorded token counts, not read from the run files.

tokens.reasoning_double_count_note: reasoning_tokens are INSIDE output_tokens (completion_tokens). They are not added again.

normalized_cost_usd.basis_note: one completion per task. MondayBench is not an agent benchmark and there are no steps to multiply.
